_about: The document inventory's own data (build/case-flow/documents/inventory.cjs). obtained: how each kind of document reaches the file, by folder, with per-document overrides. challenges: for every document whose manifest key is PLANTED, the route the trainee takes to fix it, the documents that prove it, and the activities where it is worked. open: sync items found in the inventory sweep that need a decision before they are changed.

routes.cms: Correct our own record in the CMS, with a note citing the source document
routes.amend: Amendment Request to the provider (Email Workspace), with Atty. Thorne's approval; the provider corrects its own record
routes.records: Request it through ChartSwap (Medical Records Requests) on a live HIPAA authorization
routes.docket: Docket the correct date (Docket System · CMS → Calendar), counted from the right event
routes.redline: Redline it and route it to Atty. Thorne before anyone signs or serves it
routes.route: Route it to Atty. Thorne the same day; the decision is his
routes.audit: Work it item by item in the exhibit audit (keep · replace · pull · add · flag)
routes.qc: Fix the copy before it goes into any set (re-export, certify, replace)

open: RS03 and RS04 (02/10/2026) already carry the claim numbers, adjusters and the BI limit that d1m1-a1 says arrive on 02/16–02/17/2026. Decide whether to blank them as "claim not yet opened".

Some packets hand a trainee records dated after the activity: d2m2-a1 (02/23/2026) has RS20 (05/28/2026) and RS13 (02/24/2026); d1m4-a1 has RS14 (printed 06/30/2026); d2m1-a2 (03/11/2026) has RS27 (03/20/2026) and RS30, whose signed UM rejection its checkpoint says has not arrived yet.
RS29 quotes Cardinal State's Other Insurance clause and its excess form, while d2m1-a2's checkpoint says the 03/09/2026 letter does not state them. Either trim RS29 or the checkpoint.

The manifest's day and SPEC.md's day differ for RS11–RS19, RS21–RS24, RS26, RS37, RS40–RS45 and RS49. The manifest decides when a trainee sees a document; SPEC.md should follow it, or the manifest should move earlier where a document is worked before it opens.

RS54 holds 25 interrogatories, 27 requests for production and 14 requests for admission, but its cover letter, the case file, RS60 and d4m2-a1 say 30 and 15. Add three requests for production and one request for admission (none about property damage).
RS44 (as of 10/16/2026) carries Track A's 08/31/2026 UM-demand mailings, but Track B (d5m5-a1) uses it as the $486.75 pre-suit cost figure.
RS64 (printed 07/15/2026) already names the 03/2027 mediation and 05/2027 arbitration dates.

RS02's planted "neck and back" cannot be proved on Day 1 (RS20 opens on Day 2), and no Day 1 checkpoint asks for it; the first activity that can prove it is d2m3-a1. RS07's 2021 Escape and RS06's expiry are planted but no checkpoint credits catching them.
